BIG BREAKFAST (gfo)
Two eggs (fried, poached or scrambled), bacon, tomato,
sausage, hash browns, mushrooms & chef made baked
beans served with toast.
GF Stonebaked bread 3.
PUMPKIN & MUSHROOM BRUSCHETTA (gfo, v) New
Chargrilled spiced pumpkin, roast mushrooms & Spanish
onion bruschetta, topped with a poached egg & balsamic
reduction on sourdough bread.
GF Stonebaked bread 3.
BREKKIE BOWL (gf, dfo) New
Lightly sautéed kale & fresh spinach, chargrilled spiced
pumpkin & mushroom, sliced avocado served with
turmeric fried eggs finished with a sprinkle of fetta &
pumpkin seeds.
CANADIAN CHICKEN BREAKFAST New
Buttermilk fried chicken skewers with Belgium waffles,
crispy bacon served with a side of maple syrup.
EGGS ON TOAST (gfo)
Two eggs (fried, poached or scrambled) served with toast.
GF Stonebaked bread 3.
BELGIUM WAFFLES (v)
Belgium waffles with Nutella & maple syrup served with
whipped cream.

Coco buttermilk pancakes served with hot chocolate fudge
or caramel sauce, topped with baby marshmallows &
whipped cream.
ADD Ice-cream 3 | Strawberries 4 | Banana 4
CARAMELISED FRENCH TOAST (v) New
Fresh baked brioche loaf with a hint of vanilla & cinnamon,
served with fresh strawberry compote & whipped cream.
